svg.title: WORKFLOW
svg.desc: How the DoWhile Team built ColonQuest: Jira sprints, one branch and pull request per ticket, the checks of CI and the releases. The full content of this card is repeated as text below it.

g.text: Jira tickets, small PRs, green CI.
Jira tickets, each with its own branch
small commits since 26 October, all in
Every title and branch names its ticket.
main only receives tagged releases from develop.
Each one carries the Windows zip that a judge runs
FROM COSTA RICA TO THE WORLD
Every change traceable to a Jira ticket
